snippet.title: Object Impermanence - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Object Impermanence is a surreal first-person puzzle adventure built on a simple mechanic: if you can’t see it, it doesn’t exist.

Explore the ruins of a forgotten planet adrift in space, unravel puzzles that bend the laws of logic, and uncover why this world endures while the rest of the universe fades away.

✨ Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3595450/Object_Impermanence/

Developed by Slugware, founded by Julius "elosociu" and Tom Jerbo, with music by Jamal Green. 
https://open.spotify.com/artist/50jTMgIPZrjKFgHbCvoeRt?si=3lj5640oTW6A0PGbNmatyQ

Launching on Steam in early 2026.
#ObjectImpermanence #PuzzleGame #indiegame
